name: Levie Castell
source:
Scared of his powers, they hid him in the Land of the Looking Glass.

Lost and alone, the most powerful magic-wielder in the history of Cradle gave up on people. After all, he couldn't even touch them because of his magic.

But on the night of the new moon, he finally finds someone that could maybe, just maybe, thaw the ice around his heart...

[From in-game description]
